name: A Dream Beyond Light

passive: When entering battle, for each [Beast] ally present (including the carrier), the carrier gains Ultimate Might +4%, stacking up to 4 times. At the start of the round, for each type of Bullet carried, the carrier gains DMG Dealt +2% for the round, stacking up to 6 times.
